simple.meaning: בְּחֻרוֹת (bᵉchurôwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “youth (collectively and abstractly).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בְּחֻרוֹת (H979) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 11:28, with occurrences in Numbers, Ecclesiastes.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּחֻרוֹת (H979) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בְּחֻרוֹת (H979) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בְּחֻרוֹת (bᵉchurôwth) / H979 is traced through Numbers 11:28, Ecclesiastes 11:9, Ecclesiastes 12:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
